title: visual-language-palette-lab
universal_lens: Visual language as a structured information geometry; color tokens encode semantic depth and cognitive load. Each hue maps to a distinct inference layer—data, intelligence, and context—forming a hierarchical Bayesian network.
gsi_mapping: GSI infers semantic layers via color-coded telemetry streams. Orbital cyan encodes live data flow; ultraviolet encodes AI reasoning. Carbon and eclipse define background/context surfaces. These map to probabilistic belief states in a conformal predictive framework.
gse_mapping: GSE transitions between cognitive states using layered visual depth. Eclipse surfaces support active intelligence; carbon provides ambient context. Layering rules enforce state transitions through nested UI hierarchies, maintaining minimal entropy in UI complexity.

primitives.name: Data Signal
primitives.verbatim_quote: --### `--orbital-cyan: #00E5FF` — The Data Signal **What it communicates**: Live data, market movement, odds context, the "intelligence is flowing" state.
primitives.assumptions: Live data must be visually distinct from static content. Color intensity reflects temporal relevance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal saturation occurs when multiple data streams overlap without visual distinction.

layer2.mapping: Encodes time-series data flow in GSI's probabilistic model. Represents dynamic evidence update rate.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of data refresh events per second

primitives.name: Intelligence Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: --### `--ultraviolet: #7A5CFF` — The Intelligence Layer **What it communicates**: AI-derived analysis, model output, confidence scoring, anything that represents the system's reasoning rather than raw data.
primitives.assumptions: AI reasoning must be visually differentiated from raw data. Color conveys abstract cognitive process.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Confusion arises when intelligence overlays are too saturated or misaligned with data.

layer2.mapping: Represents model-generated inference in GSI’s Bayesian network. Encodes confidence and reasoning depth.

primitives.name: Void Background
primitives.verbatim_quote: --### `--carbon: #0D1117` — Page Background **What it communicates**: The void behind intelligence.
primitives.assumptions: Background must remain neutral to avoid competing with foreground elements. Supports contrast and focus.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Visual clutter emerges when carbon is overused as a surface fill.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's ambient context space. Represents zero-inference baseline state.

primitives.name: Bounded Intelligence Surface
primitives.verbatim_quote: --### `--eclipse: #11161F` — Card Surface **What it communicates**: A bounded intelligence surface.
primitives.assumptions: Card surfaces must visually separate from background while maintaining cohesion. Subtlety implies boundedness.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Surface collapse occurs when elevation lacks sufficient contrast.

layer2.mapping: Represents bounded cognitive workspace in GSE. Maps to UI panel state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Panel elevation level (depth in HSL lightness units)

reasoning_traces.think:
Each color token defines a semantic layer in the visual language. Orbital cyan encodes real-time data flux, ultraviolet encodes AI reasoning, carbon defines ambient context, and eclipse defines bounded cognitive surfaces. These form a layered cognitive architecture where each layer supports distinct inference tasks. The layering rule ensures that data flows from background to foreground without visual conflict. The mathematical structure mirrors a hierarchical Bayesian model where each color represents a conditional probability distribution. Failure modes include overuse of high-contrast hues leading to visual noise, or incorrect layering causing perceptual confusion. The design enforces a minimal cognitive load by limiting depth to three levels.
